As a museum intern, I am currently working on a project to create an exhibit on the history of Eastern Europe, and I would love to learn more about your expertise in this area.

Specifically, I am interested in learning more about the battles that took place in Eastern Europe during the 17th and 18th centuries. I believe that your knowledge on this topic would be invaluable in helping me create a comprehensive and engaging exhibit.
